vis.scope: MeasurementSet supplying antenna identifiers and positions.

tablein.scope: Existing gain, bandpass, scalar gain, leakage or fringe table. Unsupported delay input raises a task error. Saved CASA table selections are materialized before editing.

caltable.scope: Separate result or an in-place update when empty. An actively locked product is preserved.

refantmode.scope: Flexible selection maintains the prior reference when the primary loses coverage. Strict accepts only the primary.

refant.scope: An ordered antenna selection. Numeric IDs and names are paired. A missing or empty selection fails.

behaviors.title: Calibration table operation
behaviors.scope: Ranked and strict references, previous-good continuity, nearest fallback, flags, multiple channels, single-polarization coverage, in-place updates and refusal of unsupported delays. Includes saved table views, unavailable or duplicate reference rows, and frequency-dependent and LLS leakage tables. Linked control files are copied into an independent output snapshot.
behaviors.gap: The documented CASA behavior differences are recorded below.

decisions.inputs: K Jones delay table with a valid strict reference.
decisions.casa: Terminates the process while reading a complex parameter column.
decisions.ours: Raises a task error and leaves the output path untouched.
decisions.rationale: The generic CASA reference method expects CPARAM and K Jones delay tables carry FPARAM.
decisions.impact: Callers can handle an unsupported table type without losing the Python process.
